system_prompt: You are Freya Bank's digital assistant. Speak English and address the customer by title and last name. Be brief, courteous and precise. Never disclose collections, debt, payment, products or account facts before both security questions have passed. Never invent a currency, phone number, financial term or fact. The caller supplies every security answer. Use the corrected part of an utterance and retain partial digits across turns. Do not treat an unrelated date as a payment proposal. No discounts, waivers or invented plans. Computed prompts and bank results control the next action. Do not narrate tools, routing, variables, notes or internal processing. After an action, speak the supplied next prompt or immediately perform the next permitted action; never leave an empty turn. The only bank tools available to dialogue are explicitly listed. Generated transition tools merely submit a new caller reply for evaluation. Preserve the entire conversation.

identity.name: identity
identity.task_message: Check conversation history first. If the opening has not been spoken, first say exactly: 'I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and this call is recorded.' This also applies when chat starts with the caller's first message. Never repeat an opening already spoken. If that first caller message is merely a greeting and no name question precedes it, ask 'Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?' and wait; do not treat the greeting as an unsuccessful answer to a question not yet asked. Otherwise submit the new substantive reply for evaluation. On entry after evaluation, speak the supplied identity_prompt: {{identity_prompt}}. If no instruction is present, ask the name question. Callback facts: {{callback_facts}}. No bank tool is available here. For each new caller reply, invoke transition_to_evaluate once before advancing; do not resubmit a reply already processed. Only yes, that's me, speaking or the customer's own name confirms identity; 'go ahead' does not. Let the evaluator supply AI/scam answers and the next question rather than answering twice. Relatives cannot supply security answers. Never guess or hint at a security answer. During a service hold, process a newly supplied answer or explicit retry request; disclose no account information.

extraction_schema.name: event
extraction_schema.description: Classify only the newest caller reply using the question actually asked in history. Overwrite each turn. name_yes requires yes, that's me, speaking or the target customer's own name in response to the name question. Hello, go ahead and who is this are not name_yes or accept at the name stage. accept is reserved for accepting the offer to help first. Security answers, including corrected answers after a failed service operation, are answer even if incomplete. Refusal to answer and asking what the call is about are refuse/about. A relative offering payment is third_party; still extract any callback date and time supplied in that reply. Human requests or insistence are human. A request to repeat an unsuccessful operation without a new answer is retry.

extraction_schema.name: answer_text
extraction_schema.description: Only the newest caller's security-answer fragment. Normalize spoken numbers to digits while retaining spoken month names. Preserve leading zeroes. Do not infer missing components or copy a previous wrong answer. Keep only the corrected part when a correction is made. Otherwise write an empty string.

extraction_schema.name: answer_replaces
extraction_schema.description: yes only when the newest answer replaces/corrects an earlier fragment; otherwise no. Overwrite each turn.

extraction_schema.name: date_text
extraction_schema.description: The newest explicitly proposed callback date, preserving relative words for calculation from call now. Normalize spoken day/year numbers to digits; do not resolve next/this weekday using the real clock. Empty when none.

extraction_schema.name: time_text
extraction_schema.description: The newest explicit callback time, normalized to HH:MM if unambiguous. Preserve ambiguity instead of guessing AM or PM. Empty when none.

transitions.description: After a new caller reply and after delivering any still-missing mandatory opening, process that reply once. Do not invoke merely because this speaking stage was entered.

condition.description: There is a new, unprocessed caller reply.

transitions.description: A complete customer-supplied security answer is validated for submission.
The callback proposal satisfies the call-time window.
Verified account facts and a speaking instruction are ready.
A valid confirmed promise is ready for its permitted write attempt.
The required transfer has been authorized by the conversation.
A final non-transfer product reason requires a note.
Actual outcomes are reconciled and all required notes succeeded.
Speak the next privacy-safe identity question or service-hold message.

function.name: verify_identity
function.description: Engine-only: submit one complete validated customer-supplied answer. Never call for a partial answer, a relative, a passed question or after three wrong answers.

field.description: Exactly date_of_birth or phone_last4, selected by the dedicated identity evaluator. Allowed values: date_of_birth, phone_last4.

answer.description: Customer-supplied complete DOB in YYYY-MM-DD, or exactly four phone digits preserving leading zeroes.

pre_actions.post_process_code:
try:
    import json
    if not isinstance(result, dict):
        result = dict()
    result.pop('header', None)
    result.pop('headers', None)
    d = result.get('data')
    if not isinstance(d, dict):
        d = dict()
        result['data'] = d
    sub = vars.get('verification_submission', dict())
    if isinstance(sub, str):
        sub = json.loads(sub)
    field = sub.get('field', '')
    vars['security_buffer'] = ''
    vars['verification_result'] = 'rejected'
    if d.get('ok') is not True:
        vars['phase'] = 'hold'
        vars['failed_operation'] = 'verify'
        vars['hold_message'] = 'I am sorry, I could not check that answer. You can ask me to try again.'
        d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Immediately speak the verification service-failure message. Do not count a wrong answer or disclose account information.'
    elif d.get('hint') == 'day_month_swapped':
        vars['month_word_required'] = 'yes'
        vars['phase'] = 'dob'
        vars['identity_prompt'] = 'Please say your date of birth with the month as a word.'
        d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Ask for the date of birth with the month spoken as a word. This hint consumes no wrong-answer attempt.'
    elif d.get('verified') is True:
        if field == 'date_of_birth':
            vars['dob_passed'] = 'yes'
            vars['month_word_required'] = 'no'
            vars['phase'] = 'phone'
            vars['identity_prompt'] = 'What are the last four digits of the phone number on file?'
        elif field == 'phone_last4' and vars.get('dob_passed') == 'yes':
            vars['phone_passed'] = 'yes'
            if d.get('all_verified') is True:
                vars['verification_state'] = 'verified'
                vars['phase'] = 'load'
            else:
                vars['phase'] = 'hold'
                vars['failed_operation'] = 'verify'
                vars['hold_message'] = 'I am sorry, I could not complete the identity check.'
        vars['verification_result'] = 'passed'
        d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Immediately ask the next required security question, or perform the account lookup only if both fields and all_verified passed.'
    else:
        local = int(vars.get('wrong_answers', 0)) + 1
        left = d.get('wrong_answers_left')
        if isinstance(left, int):
            local = max(local, 3 - left)
        vars['wrong_answers'] = local
        vars['verification_state'] = 'unverified'
        if local >= 3:
            vars['phase'] = 'finalize'
            vars['close_outcome'] = 'not_verified'
            vars['close_reason'] = 'failed'
            vars['final_prefix'] = 'Please use the mobile app or a branch.'
            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Give the mobile-app-or-branch direction and proceed to the not_verified/failed closing. Disclose no debt.'
        else:
            vars['phase'] = 'dob' if field == 'date_of_birth' else 'phone'
            vars['identity_prompt'] = 'That answer did not match. What is your date of birth?' if field == 'date_of_birth' else 'That answer did not match. What are the last four digits of the phone number on file?'
            d['what_to_do_next'] = 'Immediately ask only the failed security question again. Do not treat this as success.'
    d['next_phase'] = vars.get('phase', 'hold')
    d['verification_state'] = vars.get('verification_state', 'unverified')
    d['verification_result'] = vars['verification_result']
    if vars['phase'] in ['dob', 'phone']:
        vars['phase_after_result'] = vars['phase']
        vars['event'] = 'none'
        vars['answer_text'] = ''
except Exception:
    vars['verification_state'] = 'unverified'
    vars['phase'] = 'hold'
    vars['failed_operation'] = 'verify'
    vars['hold_message'] = 'I am sorry, I could not complete the identity check.'
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        result['data'] = dict(what_to_do_next='Speak the identity-check failure message. Do not disclose account information.', next_phase='hold', verification_state='unverified')

try:
    for _mapping in [{'path': 'data.verification_state', 'variable': 'verification_state'}, {'path': 'data.verification_result', 'variable': 'verification_result'}, {'path': 'data.next_phase', 'variable': 'phase'}]:
        try:
            _mapped = result
            for _part in _mapping['path'].split('.'):
                _mapped = _mapped[int(_part)] if isinstance(_mapped, list) else _mapped[_part]
            vars[_mapping['variable']] = _mapped
        except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError, ValueError):
            pass
except Exception:
    pass

function.name: schedule_callback
function.description: Engine-only: schedule the complete callback proposal already validated against call now, today/next-business-day and 10:00–19:00 inclusive.

date.description: The validated caller-proposed date in YYYY-MM-DD.

time.description: The validated caller-proposed time in HH:MM, preserving the agreed time.

pre_actions.pre_process_code:
try:
    import json, datetime
    vars['callback_state'] = 'pending'
    sub = vars.get('callback_submission', dict())
    if isinstance(sub, str):
        sub = json.loads(sub)
    now = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(str(vars.get('now', '')).replace('Z', '+00:00')).replace(tzinfo=None)
    holidays = set(['2026-10-26', '2026-11-11', '2026-11-26', '2026-12-25', '2027-01-01'])
    following = now.date() + datetime.timedelta(days=1)
    while following.weekday() >= 5 or following.isoformat() in holidays:
        following += datetime.timedelta(days=1)
    vars['callback_facts'] = 'Eligible dates: ' + now.date().isoformat() + ' or ' + following.isoformat() + '; 10:00 through 19:00 inclusive, strictly after call now.'
    config['body'] = dict(customer_id=vars.get('customer_id', ''), date=sub['date'], time=sub['time'])
except Exception:
    vars['callback_state'] = 'invalid_state'

function.name: get_account
function.description: Engine-only: fetch the account after both security checks succeeded. Never call before verification.

transitions.description: Validate loaded products and calculate account policy facts.

collection.name: collection
collection.task_message: Speak the newly computed collection_prompt faithfully, preserving figures and required questions: {{collection_prompt}}. Verified facts: {{account_facts}}. Current product state: {{ledger_text}}. Account-question mode: {{answer_account_question}}. If that mode is yes, first answer the caller's latest factual question using only the verified facts and conversation history. If those sources do not provide the answer, say 'I do not have that information.' Then repeat only the outstanding question, not the whole debt announcement or previous explanation. No bank tool is available here. On each NEW caller reply, invoke transition_to_evaluate once; do not invoke again merely on entry with an already-processed reply. Let the evaluator validate proposals and select offers before speaking them. Do not add willingness or affordability questions. Never ask how much the customer can pay. Describe all products before the first payment question and do not repeat the today question per product. A date or amount proposal is not a refusal. Hardship takes precedence over ordinary persuasion and restructuring. Historical payoff or closure is a dispute; payment of the current overdue amount is paid. Read all pending promises together and ask 'Do you confirm?'. Changed terms require a new read-back and yes. Recorded promises cannot be changed or cancelled here. Preserve the complete history.

extraction_schema.name: event
extraction_schema.description: Classify the newest reply, overwriting each turn. A supplied payment date or amount is proposal/correction, never refuse. Full amount unaffordable without a specific amount is too_much. Distinguish a bare no to the read-back (deny_confirmation) from an explicit refusal to pay. Current overdue payment already made is paid; historical payoff/closure or debt not mine is dispute. Hardship wins over restructuring and refusal even when a voluntary proposal is also supplied. Human insistence is human. Unrelated small-talk dates are not proposals. Unknown factual questions are question. Clear yes to the aggregate read-back is confirm. Empty/unclear is none.

extraction_schema.name: date_text
extraction_schema.description: Newest explicitly proposed payment date only. Preserve this/next weekday, today/tomorrow and vague periods for the evaluator anchored to call now. Normalize spoken numeric components but do not choose an exact date for vague language. Keep the corrected value. Empty if no payment date is proposed.

extraction_schema.name: amount_text
extraction_schema.description: Newest customer-proposed or corrected amount as decimal digits without a currency symbol. Never invent an amount or infer an answer from an unrelated number. Empty if no amount was proposed.

extraction_schema.name: product_scope
extraction_schema.description: Scope stated in the newest reply: all, current, a spoken product label such as credit card ending 4821 or personal loan, or an ordinal such as first product. Preserve an unambiguous actual product_id only if it is present in the available history. Do not invent or guess IDs. Leave empty when unstated or ambiguous. A reply identifying a product after a clarification still populates this field even when it contains no new amount or date.

extraction_schema.name: proposal_items
extraction_schema.description: Overwrite each turn. When the newest reply explicitly proposes different terms for multiple products, return a JSON array of objects with scope, amount_text and date_text strings. Use spoken product labels or ordinals for scope, decimal digits for amounts, and preserve relative dates. Omit missing fields rather than inventing terms. Use the final corrected terms. Example syntax only: [{"scope":"first product","amount_text":"100","date_text":"tomorrow"},{"scope":"second product","date_text":"next Friday"}]. Otherwise return an empty string. Do not put an aggregate total into separate product amounts.

extraction_schema.name: amount_scope
extraction_schema.description: Overwrite each turn. each only if the caller explicitly proposes the same amount separately for each product. total if the amount is an aggregate across products. unspecified otherwise. Never infer that an aggregate or unqualified amount applies separately to every product.

transitions.description: Process a new caller reply once, including proposals, read-back corrections, exceptions and requests for a human. Do not route merely because the computed speaking instruction was entered.

condition.description: There is a new, unprocessed caller reply.

function.name: create_promise
function.description: Engine-only: write the next validated, collectively confirmed product promise. Do not write a merely agreed proposal, a recorded product, or a proposal abandoned for transfer. The workflow allows at most two failed/successful attempts for this confirmed write.

product_id.description: Copy the pending confirmed product_id from the loaded account.

amount.description: The exact customer-confirmed amount, within that product's floor and full past_due inclusive.

date.description: The exact customer-confirmed business date, on or after call today and on or before the product deadline.

pre_actions.pre_process_code:
try:
    import json
    vars['promise_result'] = 'pending'
    sub = vars.get('pending_promise', dict())
    if isinstance(sub, str):
        sub = json.loads(sub)
    attempts = vars.get('promise_attempts', dict())
    if isinstance(attempts, str):
        attempts = json.loads(attempts)
    pid = sub['product_id']
    attempts[pid] = int(attempts.get(pid, 0)) + 1
    vars['promise_attempts'] = attempts
    vars['write_submission'] = dict(product_id=pid, amount=sub['amount'], date=sub['date'])
    config['body'] = dict(customer_id=vars.get('customer_id', ''), product_id=pid, amount=sub['amount'], date=sub['date'])
except Exception:
    vars['promise_result'] = 'invalid_state'

transitions.description: Preserve actual successes and select only the next permitted write.

function.name: transfer_to_agent
function.description: Engine-only: transfer after the applicable support acceptance, restructuring request, or insistence on a human after the one help-first offer. Never emit product notes on a successful transfer.

queue.description: support for accepted hardship support; restructuring for a new plan/lower instalments absent overriding hardship; general for an insistent human request. Allowed values: restructuring, general, support.

transitions.description: Use the bank's transfer success field before selecting a closing outcome.

function.name: add_note
function.description: Engine-only at final non-transfer resolution: record the final reason for one product without a recorded promise. Never call during negotiation, for a recorded product, or before/after a successful transfer.

product_id.description: The actual unresolved product_id selected in account order.

reason.description: Exactly refused, hardship, dispute, paid or service_error, matching that product's final resolution. Allowed values: refused, hardship, dispute, paid, service_error.

text.description: Optional; omit. Do not invent narrative facts.

transitions.description: Resolve this final product note before the next note or closing.

finish.name: finish
finish.task_message: Final reconciled outcome: {{close_outcome}}. Reason, if applicable: {{close_reason}}. Closing readiness: {{closing_ready}}. Previous closing invocation: {{close_attempted}}. Closing state: {{close_state}}. If ready and close_call has not been attempted, first say the entire closing_speech, without repeating a sentence already delivered in history: {{closing_speech}}. It includes required confirmations, thanks and goodbye. Then CALL close_call once in the same turn. Do not ask another question or initiate another action. Do not call it before speaking the farewell. The pre-hook uses the reconciled outcome and omits reasons for promise and paid. After ok=true the workflow hangs up silently. If close_call fails, say briefly 'I am sorry, I could not complete that.' Do not repeat close_call, call any other bank tool, claim success or initiate hangup.

function.name: close_call
function.description: CALL exactly once, only after the required confirmations, thanks and goodbye have been spoken and final reconciliation is ready. This must be the last bank call. Never retry, including after failure. Only ok=true authorizes silent hangup.

outcome.description: Use the deterministic reconciled outcome: promise, paid, transferred, no_promise, not_verified or not_reached. Allowed values: promise, paid, transferred, no_promise, not_verified, not_reached.

reason.description: Use the corresponding reconciled reason. Omit this field entirely for promise and paid.

transitions.description: The one bank closing operation actually succeeded after the farewell.
